## Why Sales Teams Love SpotDraft

![Salesforce contract workflow showing three signers with statuses: James Miller signed, Andrea Thomas declined, and Amy David pending.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/68628d77f168dd477899127c_Frame%202147224456.avif)

### Control Contracts, Right from Your CRM

- Create, manage, and finalize contracts directly within Salesforce and HubSpot
- Access contract details, approvals, and related documents directly from Salesforce - No downloads, no switching screens
- Track every contract update with SpotDraft’s activity log
- Upload, review, and collaborate on third-party agreements—without leaving your CRM

### Faster Contracts, Faster Sales

- Automate contract generation with pre-approved templates by your legal teams
- Auto-fill key contract details—like names, dates, and deal value, close date—directly from your CRM to eliminate manual entry

![Interface screen showing a button labeled 'New contract' and a section titled 'Acme Inc templates' with a search bar and a selected contract template named 'Master service agreement'.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/68628d113bdce67d22300ffb_Group%201171275656.avif)

![Activity log showing four entries: Salesforce icon with text 'Contract details added to Salesforce'; document icon with text 'James MSH has been moved to Executed stage'; photo of a woman with text 'LEGAL Manager Acme MSA has been approved'; photo of a man with text 'SALES Manager @Legal can you approve the change in payment terms'.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/68628dde3d8a286f4118148b_Frame%202147224451%20(1).avif)

### Break Down Silos Between Sales and Legal

- Ensure transparency with bi-directional sync that keeps contract data updated in real-time, eliminating email or Slack back-and-forth between Legal and Sales
- Accelerate the closing process with automated approval requests and eSignatures

INTEGRATIONS

## Integrate SpotDraft where your team works, not around it

![Salesforce logo](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/686297abf44886fee7f7c3e3_Frame%202147223485.svg)

### Salesforce

Revolutionize your contract management workflow with seamless Salesforce integration

Key Features

- Create contracts using Salesforce data directly within the CRM
- Upload and manage third-party agreements
- View contract status, approvals, metadata, activity log, and related documents—right within Salesforce
- View, edit and sync contract metadata back to Salesforce custom objects
- Collaborate via activity logs and manage approvals in context

[Explore more\\
![Arrow icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/68513d054ed0fc879519b9a5_Frame%202147224255.svg)](https://www.spotdraft.com/integrations/salesforce)

![HubSpot logo](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/686297c81f0c8333b59d7306_Group%201171275498.svg)

### HubSpot

Create and manage contracts efficiently without leaving HubSpot

Key Features

- Generate contracts using HubSpot Deal, Company, and Contact data
- Customize contract actions based on your workflow
- Filter template availability by deal stages
- Upload third-party agreements for streamlined review
- Fetch currency and line item data from HubSpot deals

[Explore more\\
![Arrow icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/68513d054ed0fc879519b9a5_Frame%202147224255.svg)](https://www.spotdraft.com/integrations/hubspot)

![Zoho logo](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/686297ddcd47a79d37c009e3_Frame%202147223485%20(1).svg)

### Zoho

Reduce sales cycle time with fully customizable Zoho integration

Key Features

- Create contract drafts with one click from Zoho
- Add custom buttons to any Zoho object for contract creation
- Map Zoho fields to SpotDraft templates with flexible configuration
- Initiate NDAs, MSAs, and CPQs directly from your CRM
- Complete automation of data transfer between systems
